map.由需求与保费变动率求弹性: Elasticity from demand and premium change rates
map.输入需求量变动率与保费变动率，求需求弹性。: Enter the change rates of demand and premium to find demand elasticity.
map.📖 查看「由需求与保费变动率求弹性 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Elasticity from Demand and Premium Change Rates User Guide"
map.看保费涨 1% 需求降多少，判断提价空间。: See how much demand drops when premium rises 1%, to judge room for a price hike.
map.做定价策略的敏感性分析。: Do sensitivity analysis for pricing strategy.
map.弹性 = (−10%)/(+20%) = −0.5。绝对值<1 缺乏弹性，提价总: Elasticity = (-10%)/(+20%) = -0.5. Absolute value < 1 means inelastic, so a price hike raises total premium.
map.弹性负号怎么读？: How to read the negative sign of elasticity?
map.需求与保费反向，弹性为负；看绝对值。|E|<1 可提价增收入，|E|>1 应降价: Demand and premium move opposite, so elasticity is negative; read the absolute value. |E|<1 allows a price hike to raise revenue; |E|>1 should cut price for volume.
map.弹性大对保险公司是好事吗？: Is high elasticity good for insurers?
map.中性偏风险。弹性大说明客户对价格敏感、易流失，小幅涨价就丢量；但降价也易冲量。定: Neutral but risky. High elasticity means price-sensitive, easily churned customers; a small hike loses volume, but a cut also gains volume fast. Pricing must find the profit-maximizing point between price and volume, not just hike.
